verdict.rationale: Notte documents a public API reference, including Bearer-token authentication and an agent-start endpoint used to create cloud browser sessions, scrape pages and run web agents. Sessions are described as controllable programmatically, and a CDP endpoint is exposed. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes at common paths returned 404), detailed endpoint-by-endpoint coverage in the evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: All API requests require a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header.
used to create cloud browser sessions, scrape webpages, and run web ai agents to act on your behalf on the internet
